heading: Today
text: Sunshine, mixing with clouds.  Scattered showers, thunderstorms increasing in NY, localized in VT later.  Warm, muggy.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Localized evening showers, storms, then partly cloudy. Warm, very humid.

heading: Friday
text: Partly sunny. Slight chance of an afternoon showers or storm. Very warm, very humid.

heading: Saturday
text: Mix of sun and clouds. A good chance of showers, thunderstorms north, scattered south.
